events.description: High volume of rapid failed login attempts from a single internal IP address indicating a potential credential stuffing or brute force attack.
events.action: Temporarily block IP 192.168.1.100, enforce password resets for targeted accounts, and scan the source host for compromise.

events.description: An unusually large data download of 15.5 GB was detected from internal IP 10.0.0.55, which may indicate compromise or an insider threat attempting to exfiltrate sensitive cloud data.
events.action: Isolate IP 10.0.0.55, revoke active session tokens for the associated user, and audit cloud storage logs to identify accessed files.

events.description: An internal IP address scanned 1000 ports, indicating active network discovery which may precede a targeted attack.
events.action: Isolate host 172.16.0.200, inspect running processes, and review security group/firewall logs.
